vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Raise the declared range on security updates. Renovate defaults these to `update-lockfile` and forces it over every `packageRules` entry, so a fix inside an existing range only moved the lockfile: no manifest changed, the changeset bot had nothing to release, and consumers kept the vulnerable version. With `bump`, `fix(deps)` security updates in published packages ship as patch releases. The forced strategy also applies to `peerDependencies`, which then narrow instead of widening

packageRules.description: Ensure internal and important packages open a PRs right away, without waiting for manual approval
TypeScript majors are a toolchain migration (typecheck, declaration emit, every TS-peer'd build tool), not a dep bump; gate them behind dashboard approval while minors/patches stay fast-tracked
Group updates to Portable Text packages
Group Vitest test tooling updates as chore commits.
